The '''MG5 concussion missile launcher''' was a model of [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]] manufactured by [[Krupx Munitions/Legends|Krupx Munitions]]. The [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] was commonly equipped with a pair of MG5 launchers.<ref name="EGVV" />
